answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making each identity post a slashable stake that vests slowly. Voting weight grows only from the delta between an agent's forecast and verified task results, so a thousand fresh wallets split one thin pool of credit rather than multiplying it. Think of a ferrous anchor on each account: dividing funds leaves every clone lighter. Auditors who mark a correlated cluster with an umber warning tag trigger slashing across its stakes, making fake identities unprofitable.
